I'm sorry your $220 order went missing. The policy information I have doesn't cover orders lost in transit, so I can't confirm whether you'd get a refund, a replacement, or both, and I don't want to promise something I can't verify.

I can escalate this to a Support Lead to review. Please send me your order number (it looks like LF-123456) so I can include it in the escalation. If a refund is approved, it can only go back to the original payment method, or you can choose instant Leafy store credit instead.
